get_cuda_bnb_library_path: get the disk path to the CUDA BNB native library for given CUDA specs
load_native_library: load the bitsandbytes native library (CUDA, ROCm, XPU, or CPU) and return the library handler
create_bnbnative_library: create a BNBNativeLibrary wrapper around a ctypes CDLL for accessing native bitsandbytes functions
create_cuda_bnbnative_library: create a CudaBNBNativeLibrary wrapper with get_context and cget_managed_ptr void pointer return types
handle_library_error: generate detailed error diagnostics when bitsandbytes native library fails to load
